title: A counterexample to the coarse Novikov conjecture
main_claim: There is a uniformly discrete bounded-geometry space X (a coarse disjoint union of finite bounded-degree graphs: triangular-lattice discs with SL_3(Z/2^k) congruence fibers growing with depth, glued by twisted right-holonomy edges) and an infinite-order class alpha in KX_1(X) with mu_X(alpha)=0 in K_1(C*(X)). So reduced coarse assembly is not injective, either integrally or rationally.
coverage: I read the whole paper (sections 1–6) and checked each step of the proof chain. (a) Generation and surjectivity of the congruence tower. I checked the 2x2 elementary-matrix identity by hand. The kernel bound h=2^9 holds, including |SL_3(F_2)|=168 at k=0. (b) Trace separation. t is a transcendental 2-adic unit, so each finite difference t^m+t^{-m}+1-tr(w) is a nonzero 2-adic integer, and N(A) can exceed all their valuations. (c) Small-loop lemma. If rho(u) > floor(n/2), the half-plane f>0 contains the whole projected loop, so its winding (and hence its charge) is 0. Reducing to the minimum depth l gives w z g^m = z, because left and right multiplications commute; this is checked in all three edge cases. Then tr g_l^m = tr w^{-1} mod 2^l, which contradicts trace separation once j >= N(A)+floor(A/2). (d) Persistence. At each scale r, P_r(X_j) is a clopen component for large j, and b_r is a well-defined integral cocycle (closed paths of length <= 2r and <= 3r). It sums to 1 around C_j, and restricting to a clopen component is the coordinate projection, so lambda_r(n alpha_r)=n. Because the test is applied separately at each scale, the direct-limit argument is valid. (e) Transfer. The bipartite support splits into <=2b_R-1 matchings. The bound ||P_n A P_n - P A P|| <= 2||P_n-P|| ||A|| holds. P A_T P = V T V* holds because O_uv xi_v = xi_u. The sandwich is locally compact with finite propagation. The (T) spectral gap is uniform: <L eta,eta> = (1/2|S|) sum ||s eta - eta||^2 >= kappa^2/(2|S|). The child maps J_a are isometries carrying normalized constants to normalized constants, since |Q_{k+1}| = h_k |Q_k|. The cross-component pairs are finite. (f) Vanishing. P_1(B) -> W -> P_1(D) with K_1^lf(W) = product of K_1(pt) = 0. VE=I holds exactly because the boundary fibers are trivial, so Ad V ∘ Ad E = Ad I, and naturality gives mu_X(alpha)=0. I did not re-derive the standard naturality and Rips-identification facts the paper cites from Willett–Yu, or the transportation-metric comparison in Section 2. Neither is load-bearing beyond standard results.
